messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: The Crestor brand of rosuvastatin tablets is distributed by AstraZeneca Pharmaceuticals LP.
AstraZeneca Pharmaceuticals LP is located in Wilmington, DE 19850.
The distribution is under license from Shionogi & Co., LTD.
Shionogi & Co., LTD. is located in Osaka, Japan.
Generic versions are also manufactured by several other companies.
Ezallor Sprinkle (rosuvastatin) has been discontinued and is no longer available.
Triplet: ["Crestor", "distributed under license from", "Shionogi & Co., LTD"]

The relation 'distributed under license from' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is distributed by the company specified by the object entity under a licensing agreement.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
B. 'has brand name': The subject drug is marketed under the brand or trade name specified by the object entity.
C. 'manufacturer location': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by a company located in the place specified by the object entity.
D. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
E. 'has multiple brands and forms': The subject drug is available in multiple brands and forms as specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
